t.en: Introduction to Plotting
t.zh: 绘图简介

t.en: Earlier versions of Octave provided plotting through the use of gnuplot. This capability is still available. But, newer versions of Octave offer more modern plotting capabilities using OpenGL. Which plotting system is used is controlled by the `graphics_toolkit` function. See Graphics Toolkits.
t.zh: 早期版本的 Octave 通过 gnuplot 进行绘图，这一功能依然可用；不过新版本的 Octave 借助 OpenGL 提供了更现代的绘图能力。具体使用哪一套绘图系统，由 `graphics_toolkit` 函数控制。参见 Graphics Toolkits 一节。

t.en: The function call `graphics_toolkit ("qt")` selects the Qt/OpenGL system, `graphics_toolkit ("fltk")` selects the FLTK/OpenGL system, and `graphics_toolkit ("gnuplot")` selects the gnuplot system. The three systems may be used selectively through the use of the `graphics_toolkit` property of the graphics handle for each figure. This is explained in Graphics Data Structures.
t.zh: 调用 `graphics_toolkit ("qt")` 选择 Qt/OpenGL 系统，`graphics_toolkit ("fltk")` 选择 FLTK/OpenGL 系统，`graphics_toolkit ("gnuplot")` 选择 gnuplot 系统。通过每个图形窗口（figure）的图形句柄上的 `graphics_toolkit` 属性，这三套系统可以按需混用。详见 Graphics Data Structures 一节。

t.en: **Caution:** The OpenGL-based toolkits use single precision variables internally which limits the maximum value that can be displayed to approximately $10^{38}$. If your data contains larger values you must use the gnuplot toolkit which supports values up to $10^{308}$. Similarly, single precision variables can accurately represent only 6-9 base10 digits. If your data contains very fine differences (approximately 1e-8) these cannot be resolved with the OpenGL-based graphics toolkits and the gnuplot toolkit is required.
t.zh: **注意：**基于 OpenGL 的工具包在内部使用单精度变量，因此能显示的最大值约为 $10^{38}$。如果你的数据中有更大的值，就必须使用 gnuplot 工具包，它支持的数值可达 $10^{308}$。同样，单精度变量只能准确表示 6～9 位十进制有效数字。如果数据中存在非常细微的差异（约 1e-8），基于 OpenGL 的图形工具包无法分辨它们，这时需要使用 gnuplot 工具包。

t.en: **Note:** The gnuplot graphics toolkit uses the third party program gnuplot for plotting. The communication from Octave to gnuplot is done via a one-way pipe. This has implications for performance and functionality. Performance is significantly slower because the entire data set, which could be many megabytes, must be passed to gnuplot over the pipe. Functionality is negatively affected because the pipe is one-way from Octave to gnuplot. Octave has no way of knowing about user interactions with the plot window (be it resizing, moving, closing, or anything else). It is recommended not to interact with (or close) a gnuplot window if you will access the figure from Octave later on.
t.zh: **说明：**gnuplot 图形工具包使用第三方程序 gnuplot 来绘图。Octave 与 gnuplot 之间通过一条单向管道通信，这会影响性能和功能。性能明显变慢，是因为整个数据集（可能有好几兆字节）都必须通过管道传给 gnuplot；功能受损，则是因为管道是从 Octave 到 gnuplot 的单向通道，Octave 无法得知用户在绘图窗口里的任何操作（无论是缩放、移动、关闭还是别的）。如果之后还要在 Octave 中访问这个图形，建议不要操作（也不要关闭）gnuplot 窗口。

t.en: If a single data argument is supplied, it is taken as the set of *y* coordinates and the *x* coordinates are taken to be the indices of the elements, starting with 1.
t.zh: 如果只给出一个数据参数，它被当作 *y* 坐标的集合，而 *x* 坐标取为各元素的下标，从 1 开始。

t.en: If *x* and *y* are scalars, a single point is plotted.

t.en: `squeeze()` is applied to arguments with more than two dimensions, but no more than two singleton dimensions.

t.en: If both arguments are vectors, the elements of *y* are plotted versus the elements of *x*.
t.zh: 如果两个参数都是向量，则以 *x* 的元素为横坐标，绘制 *y* 的各元素。

t.en: If *x* is a vector and *y* is a matrix, then the columns (or rows) of *y* are plotted versus *x*. (using whichever combination matches, with columns tried first.)
t.zh: 如果 *x* 是向量而 *y* 是矩阵，则以 *x* 为横坐标，绘制 *y* 的各列（或各行）。（哪种组合能匹配就用哪种，优先尝试按列。）

t.en: If the *x* is a matrix and *y* is a vector, *y* is plotted versus the columns (or rows) of *x*. (using whichever combination matches, with columns tried first.)
t.zh: 如果 *x* 是矩阵而 *y* 是向量，则以 *x* 的各列（或各行）为横坐标，绘制 *y*。（哪种组合能匹配就用哪种，优先尝试按列。）

t.en: If both arguments are matrices, the columns of *y* are plotted versus the columns of *x*. In this case, both matrices must have the same number of rows and columns and no attempt is made to transpose the arguments to make the number of rows match.
t.zh: 如果两个参数都是矩阵，则以 *x* 的各列为横坐标，绘制 *y* 的各列。此时两个矩阵的行数和列数必须都相同，Octave 不会为了让行数匹配而去转置参数。

t.en: Multiple property-value pairs may be specified, but they must appear in pairs. These arguments are applied to the line objects drawn by `plot`. Useful properties to modify are `"linestyle"`, `"linewidth"`, `"color"`, `"marker"`, `"markersize"`, `"markeredgecolor"`, `"markerfacecolor"`. The full list of properties is documented at Line Properties.
t.zh: 可以指定多组属性–值对，但它们必须成对出现。这些参数作用于 `plot` 所画出的线对象。常用的可修改属性有 `"linestyle"`、`"linewidth"`、`"color"`、`"marker"`、`"markersize"`、`"markeredgecolor"`、`"markerfacecolor"`。完整的属性列表见 Line Properties 一节。

t.en: The *fmt* format argument can also be used to control the plot style. It is a string composed of four optional parts: "<linestyle><marker><color><;displayname;>". When a marker is specified, but no linestyle, only the markers are plotted. Similarly, if a linestyle is specified, but no marker, then only lines are drawn. If both are specified then lines and markers will be plotted. If no *fmt* and no *property*/*value* pairs are given, then the default plot style is solid lines with no markers and the color determined by the `"colororder"` property of the current axes.
t.zh: 也可以用格式参数 *fmt* 来控制绘图样式。它是一个由四个可选部分组成的字符串：“<linestyle><marker><color><;displayname;>”。只指定了标记而没有线型时，只绘制标记；同样，只指定了线型而没有标记时，只画线；两者都指定时，线和标记都会绘制。如果既没有给出 *fmt*，也没有给出 *property*/*value* 属性–值对，则默认的绘图样式是不带标记的实线，颜色由当前坐标轴的 `"colororder"` 属性决定。

t.en: Produce histogram counts or plots.

t.en: With one vector input argument, *y*, plot a histogram of the values with 10 bins. The range of the histogram bins is determined by the range of the data (difference between maximum and minimum value in *y*). Extreme values are lumped into the first and last bins. t.zh: 只给出一个向量输入参数 *y* 时，绘制该数据的直方图，分为 10 个区间（bin）。直方图各区间的范围由数据的范围（*y* 中最大值与最小值之差）决定，极端值归入第一个和最后一个区间。如果 *y* 是矩阵，则绘制这样的直方图：每个区间对每一列输入各有一个条形。

t.zh: 参数 *x* 和 *y* 可以是向量或矩阵。如果只给出一个参数，它被当作 Y 值的向量，X 坐标取为各元素的下标（`x = 1:numel (y)`）。

t.en: The style to use for the plot can be defined with a line style *style* of the same format as the `plot` command.
t.zh: 绘图样式可以用线型 *style* 指定，其格式与 `plot` 命令相同。

t.en: Multiple property/value pairs may be specified, but they must appear in pairs. The full list of properties is documented at Line Properties.
t.zh: 可以指定多组属性/值对，但它们必须成对出现。完整的属性列表见 Line Properties 一节。

t.en: Plot a 2-D stem graph.
t.zh: 绘制二维火柴杆图（stem graph）。

t.en: If only one argument is given, it is taken as the y-values and the x-coordinates are taken from the indices of the elements.
t.zh: 如果只给出一个参数，它被当作 y 值，x 坐标取自各元素的下标。

t.en: If *y* is a matrix, then each column of the matrix is plotted as a separate stem graph. In this case *x* can either be a vector, the same length as the number of rows in *y*, or it can be a matrix of the same size as *y*.
t.zh: 如果 *y* 是矩阵，则矩阵的每一列被绘制成一幅单独的火柴杆图。此时 *x* 既可以是长度等于 *y* 行数的向量，也可以是与 *y* 同样大小的矩阵。

t.en: The default color is `"b"` (blue), the default line style is `"-"`, and the default marker is `"o"`. The line style can be altered by the *linespec* argument in the same manner as the `plot` command. If the `"filled"` argument is present the markers at the top of the stems will be filled in. For example,
t.zh: 默认颜色是 `"b"`（蓝色），默认线型是 `"-"`，默认标记是 `"o"`。线型可以像 `plot` 命令那样，通过 *linespec* 参数修改。如果给出 `"filled"` 参数，则杆顶的标记会被填充。例如，

t.en: plots 10 stems with heights from 2 to 20 in red;
t.zh: 用红色绘制 10 根高度从 2 到 20 的杆；

t.en: Optional property/value pairs may be specified to control the appearance of the plot. The full list of properties is documented at Line Properties.
t.zh: 可以指定可选的属性/值对来控制图形的外观。完整的属性列表见 Line Properties 一节。

The single hggroup handle has all of the graphical elements comprising the plot as its children; This allows the properties of multiple graphics objects to be changed by modifying just a single property of the "stem series" hggroup.

t.zh: 标记的边框颜色。（默认：取 `"color"` 属性）

t.en: Draw a 2-D scatter plot.
t.zh: 绘制二维散点图。

t.en: A marker is plotted at each point defined by the coordinates in the vectors *x* and *y*.
t.zh: 在向量 *x* 和 *y* 的坐标所确定的每个点处绘制一个标记。

t.en: The size of the markers is determined by *s*, which can be a scalar or a vector of the same length as *x* and *y*. If *s* is not given, or is an empty matrix, then a default value of 36 square points is used (The marker size itself is `sqrt (s)`).
t.zh: 标记的大小由 *s* 决定，它可以是标量，也可以是与 *x*、*y* 等长的向量。如果没有给出 *s*，或 *s* 是空矩阵，则使用默认值 36 平方点（标记本身的大小是 `sqrt (s)`）。

t.en: The color of the markers is determined by *c*, which can be a string defining a fixed color; a 3-element vector giving the red, green, and blue components of the color; a vector of the same length as *x* that gives a scaled index into the current colormap; or an Nx3 matrix defining the RGB color of each marker individually.
t.zh: 标记的颜色由 *c* 决定。*c* 可以是定义固定颜色的字符串；可以是给出颜色红、绿、蓝分量的 3 元素向量；可以是与 *x* 等长、给出当前色图中缩放后索引的向量；也可以是 Nx3 矩阵，逐个定义每个标记的 RGB 颜色。

t.en: The marker to use can be changed with the *style* argument; it is a string defining a marker in the same manner as the `plot` command. If no marker is specified it defaults to `"o"` or circles. If the argument `"filled"` is given then the markers are filled.
t.zh: 使用的标记可以通过 *style* 参数修改，它是定义标记的字符串，写法与 `plot` 命令相同。如果没有指定标记，默认为 `"o"`，即圆圈。如果给出 `"filled"` 参数，则标记会被填充。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则绘制到这个坐标轴中，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: The optional return value *h* is a graphics handle to the created scatter object.
t.zh: 可选的返回值 *h* 是所创建散点对象的图形句柄。

t.en: Plot level curves (contour lines) of the matrix *z*, using the contour matrix *c* computed by `contourc` from the same arguments; see the latter for their interpretation.

t.en: The appearance of contour lines can be defined with a line style *style* in the same manner as `plot`. Only line style and color are used; Any markers defined by *style* are ignored.

t.zh: 可选的输出 *c* 以 `contourc` 的格式给出各等高线的取值。

t.en: The appearance of contour lines can be defined with a line style *style* in the same manner as `plot`. Only line style and color are used; Any markers defined by *style* are ignored.

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.

t.en: The level curves are taken from the contour matrix *c* computed by `contourc` for the same arguments; see the latter for their interpretation.

t.en: The appearance of contour lines can be defined with a line style *style* in the same manner as `plot`. Only line style and color are used; Any markers defined by *style* are ignored.

t.zh: 可选的返回值 *h* 是由各条等高线组成的 hggroup 的图形句柄。

t.en: Create a 2-D plot from polar coordinates *theta* and *rho*.
t.zh: 根据极坐标 *theta* 和 *rho* 创建二维图。

t.en: The input *theta* is assumed to be radians and is converted to degrees for plotting. If you have degrees then you must convert (`cart2pol`) to radians before passing the data to this function.
t.zh: 输入 *theta* 被当作弧度，绘图时会转换为角度。如果你手头的是角度，必须先转换（`cart2pol`）成弧度，再把数据传给这个函数。

t.en: If a single complex input *cplx* is given then the real part is used for *theta* and the imaginary part is used for *rho*.
t.zh: 如果只给出一个复数输入 *cplx*，则实部用作 *theta*，虚部用作 *rho*。

t.en: The optional argument *fmt* specifies the line format in the same way as `plot`.
t.zh: 可选参数 *fmt* 指定线的格式，写法与 `plot` 相同。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则绘制到这个坐标轴中，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: The optional return value *h* is a graphics handle to the created plot.
t.zh: 可选的返回值 *h* 是所创建图形的图形句柄。

t.en: Implementation Note: The polar axis is drawn using line and text objects encapsulated in an hggroup. The hggroup properties are linked to the original axes object such that altering an appearance property, for example `fontname`, will update the polar axis. Two new properties are added to the original axes--`rtick`, `ttick`--which replace `xtick`, `ytick`. The first is a list of tick locations in the radial (rho) direction; The second is a list of tick locations in the angular (theta) direction specified in degrees, i.e., in the range 0--359. See also: `rose`, `compass`, `plot`, `cart2pol`.
t.zh: 实现说明：极坐标轴是用线对象和文本对象绘制的，它们封装在一个 hggroup 中。该 hggroup 的属性与原始的坐标轴对象相关联，因此修改某个外观属性（例如 `fontname`），极坐标轴也会随之更新。原坐标轴上新增了两个属性——`rtick` 和 `ttick`——用来取代 `xtick` 和 `ytick`。前者是径向（rho）方向上的刻度位置列表；后者是角度（theta）方向上的刻度位置列表，以度为单位，即取值范围为 0--359。另见：`rose`、`compass`、`plot`、`cart2pol`。

t.en: Plot a 2-D vector field with arrows.
t.zh: 用箭头绘制二维向量场。

t.en: Plot the (*u*, *v*) components of a vector field at the grid points defined by (*x*, *y*). If the grid is uniform then *x* and *y* can be specified as vectors and `meshgrid` is used to create the 2-D grid.
t.zh: 在由 (*x*, *y*) 确定的网格点上，绘制向量场的 (*u*, *v*) 分量。如果网格是均匀的，*x* 和 *y* 可以指定为向量，此时用 `meshgrid` 创建二维网格。

t.en: If *x* and *y* are not given they are assumed to be `(1:m, 1:n)` where `[m, n] = size (u)`.
t.zh: 如果没有给出 *x* 和 *y*，则假定它们为 `(1:m, 1:n)`，其中 `[m, n] = size (u)`。

t.en: The optional input *s* is a scalar defining a scaling factor to use for the arrows of the field relative to the mesh spacing. A value of 1.0 will result in the longest vector exactly filling one grid square. A value of 0 disables all scaling. The default value is 0.9.
t.zh: 可选输入 *s* 是标量，定义箭头相对于网格间距的缩放系数。取值 1.0 时，最长的向量恰好占满一个网格方格；取值 0 则关闭所有缩放。默认值为 0.9。

t.en: The style to use for the plot can be defined with a line style *style* of the same format as the `plot` command. If a marker is specified then the markers are drawn at the origin of the vectors (which are the grid points defined by *x* and *y*). When a marker is specified, the arrowhead is not drawn. If the argument `"filled"` is given then the markers are filled.
t.zh: 绘图样式可以用线型 *style* 指定，其格式与 `plot` 命令相同。如果指定了标记，则标记画在各向量的起点（即由 *x* 和 *y* 确定的网格点）上，此时不画箭头。如果给出 `"filled"` 参数，则标记会被填充。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则绘制到这个坐标轴中，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: The optional return value *h* is a graphics handle to a quiver object. A quiver object regroups the components of the quiver plot (body, arrow, and marker), and allows them to be changed together.
t.zh: 可选的返回值 *h* 是 quiver 对象的图形句柄。quiver 对象把箭头图的各个组成部分（杆、箭头和标记）归并在一起，可以一并修改。

t.en: Area plot of the columns of *y*.
t.zh: *y* 各列的面积图。

t.en: This plot shows the contributions of each column value to the row sum. It is functionally similar to `plot (x, cumsum (y, 2))`, except that the area under the curve is shaded.
t.zh: 这种图展示每一列的值对各行之和的贡献。它在功能上类似于 `plot (x, cumsum (y, 2))`，只是曲线下方的区域被着色。

t.en: If the *x* argument is omitted it defaults to `1:rows (y)`. A value *lvl* can be defined that determines where the base level of the shading under the curve should be defined. The default level is 0.
t.zh: 如果省略 *x* 参数，则默认为 `1:rows (y)`。可以给定一个值 *lvl*，用来确定曲线下方着色的基准高度，默认为 0。

t.en: Additional property/value pairs are passed directly to the underlying patch object. The full list of properties is documented at Patch Properties.
t.zh: 额外的属性/值对会直接传给底层的补片对象。完整的属性列表见 Patch Properties 一节。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则绘制到这个坐标轴中，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: The optional return value *h* is a graphics handle to the hggroup object comprising the area patch objects. The `"BaseValue"` property of the hggroup can be used to adjust the level where shading begins.
t.zh: 可选的返回值 *h* 是由各个面积补片对象组成的 hggroup 的图形句柄。可以通过该 hggroup 的 `"BaseValue"` 属性调整着色开始的高度。

t.en: Example: Verify identity sin^2 + cos^2 = 1
t.zh: 例：验证恒等式 sin^2 + cos^2 = 1

t.en: See also: `plot`, `patch`.
t.zh: 另见：`plot`、`patch`。

blocks.name: fill
sigs: fill (x1, y1, c1, x2, y2, c2)

t.en: Create one or more filled 2-D polygons.
t.zh: 创建一个或多个填充的二维多边形。

t.en: The inputs *x* and *y* are the coordinates of the polygon vertices. If the inputs are matrices then the rows represent different vertices and each column produces a different polygon. `fill` will close any open polygons before plotting.
t.zh: 输入 *x* 和 *y* 是多边形顶点的坐标。如果输入是矩阵，则各行代表不同的顶点，每一列生成一个不同的多边形。`fill` 在绘图之前会把所有未封闭的多边形封闭起来。

t.en: The input *c* determines the color of the polygon. The simplest form is a single color specification such as a `plot` format or an RGB-triple. In this case the polygon(s) will have one unique color. If *c* is a vector or matrix then the color data is first scaled using `caxis` and then indexed into the current colormap. A row vector will color each polygon (a column from matrices *x* and *y*) with a single computed color. A matrix *c* of the same size as *x* and *y* will compute the color of each vertex and then interpolate the face color between the vertices.
t.zh: 输入 *c* 决定多边形的颜色。最简单的形式是单一的颜色说明，例如 `plot` 的格式或 RGB 三元组，此时所有多边形都是同一种颜色。如果 *c* 是向量或矩阵，则颜色数据先用 `caxis` 缩放，再作为索引取当前色图中的颜色。行向量会给每个多边形（即矩阵 *x* 和 *y* 的一列）涂上一种算出来的颜色。与 *x*、*y* 同样大小的矩阵 *c* 会算出每个顶点的颜色，然后在顶点之间对面的颜色做插值。

t.en: Multiple property/value pairs for the underlying patch object may be specified, but they must appear in pairs. The full list of properties is documented at Patch Properties.
t.zh: 可以为底层的补片对象指定多组属性/值对，但它们必须成对出现。完整的属性列表见 Patch Properties 一节。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则绘制到这个坐标轴中，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: The optional return value *h* is a vector of graphics handles to the created patch objects.
t.zh: 可选的返回值 *h* 是一个向量，其元素是所创建补片对象的图形句柄。

t.en: Example: red square
t.zh: 例：红色正方形

blocks.text:
vertices = [0 0
             1 0
             1 1
             0 1];
 fill (vertices(:,1), vertices(:,2), "r");
 axis ([-0.5 1.5, -0.5 1.5])
 axis equal

t.en: See also: `patch`, `fill3`, `caxis`, `colormap`.
t.zh: 另见：`patch`、`fill3`、`caxis`、`colormap`。

t.en: Axis Configuration
t.zh: 坐标轴设置

t.en: The axis function may be used to change the axis limits of an existing plot and various other axis properties, such as the aspect ratio and the appearance of tic marks. By default, high level plotting functions such as `plot` reset axes properties. Any customization of properties, for example by calling `axis`, `xlim`, etc., should happen after the plot is done or, alternatively, after calling the `hold`.
t.zh: axis 函数可以修改已有图形的坐标轴范围以及其他各种坐标轴属性，例如纵横比和刻度线的外观。默认情况下，`plot` 这样的高层绘图函数会重置坐标轴属性。对属性的任何定制（例如调用 `axis`、`xlim` 等）都应该在绘图完成之后进行，或者在调用 `hold` 之后进行。

blocks.name: axis
sigs: axis ([x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi z_lo z_hi])
axis ([x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi z_lo z_hi c_lo c_hi])

t.en: Set axis limits and appearance.
t.zh: 设置坐标轴的范围和外观。

t.en: The argument *limits* should be a 2-, 4-, 6-, or 8-element vector. The first and second elements specify the lower and upper limits for the x-axis. The third and fourth specify the limits for the y-axis, the fifth and sixth specify the limits for the z-axis, and the seventh and eighth specify the limits for the color axis. The special values `-Inf` and `Inf` may be used to indicate that the limit should be automatically computed based on the data in the axes.
t.zh: 参数 *limits* 应该是含 2、4、6 或 8 个元素的向量。第一、二个元素指定 x 轴的下限和上限，第三、四个指定 y 轴的范围，第五、六个指定 z 轴的范围，第七、八个指定颜色轴的范围。特殊值 `-Inf` 和 `Inf` 可用来表示该范围应根据坐标轴中的数据自动计算。

t.en: Without any arguments, `axis` turns autoscaling on.
t.zh: 不带任何参数时，`axis` 会打开自动缩放。

t.en: With one output argument, `limits = axis` returns the current axis limits.
t.zh: 带一个输出参数时，`limits = axis` 返回当前的坐标轴范围。

t.en: The vector argument specifying limits is optional, and additional string arguments may be used to specify various axis properties.
t.zh: 指定范围的向量参数是可选的，还可以额外使用字符串参数来指定各种坐标轴属性。

t.en: The following options control the aspect ratio of the axes.
t.zh: 下列选项控制坐标轴的纵横比。

t.en: Force x-axis unit distance to equal y-axis (and z-axis) unit distance.
t.zh: 强制 x 轴的单位长度等于 y 轴（以及 z 轴）的单位长度。

t.en: Force a square axis aspect ratio.
t.zh: 强制坐标轴的纵横比为正方形。

t.en: Set aspect ratio modes (`"DataAspectRatio"`, `"PlotBoxAspectRatio"`) to `"manual"` for rotation without stretching.
t.zh: 把纵横比模式（`"DataAspectRatio"`、`"PlotBoxAspectRatio"`）设为 `"manual"`，使旋转时图形不被拉伸。

t.en: Restore default automatically computed aspect ratios.
t.zh: 恢复默认的自动计算的纵横比。

t.en: The following options control the way axis limits are interpreted.
t.zh: 下列选项控制坐标轴范围的解释方式。

t.en: Set nice auto-computed limits around the data for all axes, or only the specified axes.
t.zh: 为所有坐标轴，或只为指定的坐标轴，围绕数据设置合适的自动计算范围。

t.en: Fix the current axes limits.
t.zh: 固定当前坐标轴的范围。

t.en: Fix axes to the limits of the closest ticks.
t.zh: 把坐标轴固定在最近刻度所在的位置。

t.en: Fix axes to the limits of the data.
t.zh: 把坐标轴固定在数据的范围上。

t.en: Fix axes to the limits of the data plus margins of about 7% of the data extent.
t.zh: 把坐标轴固定在数据的范围上，并加上约为数据跨度 7% 的边距。

t.en: Equivalent to `"tight"` and `"equal"`.
t.zh: 等价于 `"tight"` 加 `"equal"`。

t.en: The following options affect the appearance of tick marks.
t.zh: 下列选项影响刻度线的外观。

t.en: Turn tick marks on for all axes, or turn them on for the specified axes and off for the remainder.
t.zh: 为所有坐标轴打开刻度线，或只为指定的坐标轴打开、其余的关闭。

t.en: Turn tick labels on for all axes, or turn them on for the specified axes and off for the remainder.
t.zh: 为所有坐标轴打开刻度标签，或只为指定的坐标轴打开、其余的关闭。

t.en: Turn tick labels off for all axes.
t.zh: 关闭所有坐标轴的刻度标签。

t.en: Note: If there are no tick marks for an axes then there can be no labels.
t.zh: 注：如果一个坐标轴没有刻度线，也就不会有刻度标签。

t.en: The following options affect the direction of increasing values on the axes.
t.zh: 下列选项影响坐标轴上数值增大的方向。

t.en: Default y-axis, larger values are near the top.
t.zh: 默认的 y 轴，较大的值靠近顶部。

t.en: Reverse y-axis, smaller values are near the top.
t.zh: 反向的 y 轴，较小的值靠近顶部。

t.en: The following options affects the visibility of the axes.
t.zh: 下列选项影响坐标轴是否可见。

t.en: Make the axes visible.
t.zh: 使坐标轴可见。

t.en: Hide the axes.
t.zh: 隐藏坐标轴。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then operate on this axes rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则作用于这个坐标轴，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: Example 1: set X/Y limits and force a square aspect ratio
t.zh: 例 1：设置 X/Y 范围，并强制纵横比为正方形

t.en: Example 2: enable tick marks on all axes, enable tick mark labels only on the y-axis
t.zh: 例 2：在所有坐标轴上打开刻度线，只在 y 轴上打开刻度标签

t.en: See also: `xlim`, `ylim`, `zlim`, `caxis`, `daspect`, `pbaspect`, `box`, `grid`.
t.zh: 另见：`xlim`、`ylim`、`zlim`、`caxis`、`daspect`、`pbaspect`、`box`、`grid`。

t.en: Similarly the axis limits of the colormap can be changed with the caxis function.
t.zh: 类似地，色图的坐标轴范围可以用 caxis 函数修改。

t.en: The `xlim`, `ylim`, and `zlim` functions may be used to get or set individual axis limits. Each has the same form.
t.zh: `xlim`、`ylim` 和 `zlim` 函数可用来获取或设置单个坐标轴的范围，三者形式相同。

t.en: Query or set the limits of the x-axis for the current plot.
t.zh: 查询或设置当前图形 x 轴的范围。

t.en: Called without arguments `xlim` returns the x-axis limits of the current plot.
t.zh: 不带参数调用时，`xlim` 返回当前图形 x 轴的范围。

t.en: With the input query `"mode"`, return the current x-limit calculation mode which is either `"auto"` or `"manual"`.
t.zh: 以查询字符串 `"mode"` 为输入时，返回当前 x 轴范围的计算模式，为 `"auto"` 或 `"manual"`。

t.en: If passed a 2-element vector [*x_lo* *x_hi*], the limits of the x-axis are set to these values and the mode is set to `"manual"`. The special values -Inf and Inf can be used to indicate that either the lower axis limit or upper axis limit should be automatically calculated.
t.zh: 如果传入 2 元素向量 [*x_lo* *x_hi*]，则 x 轴的范围被设为这两个值，并且模式被设为 `"manual"`。特殊值 -Inf 和 Inf 可用来表示坐标轴的下限或上限应由程序自动计算。

t.en: The current plotting mode can be changed by using either `"auto"` or `"manual"` as the argument.
t.zh: 也可以用 `"auto"` 或 `"manual"` 作为参数来改变当前的绘图模式。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then operate on this axes rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则作用于这个坐标轴，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: Programming Note: The `xlim` function operates by modifying the `"xlim"` and `"xlimmode"` properties of an axes object. These properties can be directly inspected and altered with `get`/`set`. See also: `ylim`, `zlim`, `axis`, `set`, `get`, `gca`.
t.zh: 编程注记：`xlim` 函数的工作方式是修改坐标轴对象的 `"xlim"` 和 `"xlimmode"` 属性。这些属性可以直接用 `get`/`set` 查看和修改。另见：`ylim`、`zlim`、`axis`、`set`、`get`、`gca`。

t.en: The `xticks`, `yticks`, `zticks`, `rticks`, and `thetaticks` functions may be used to get or set the tick mark locations and modes on the respective axis. Each has the same form, although mode options are not currently available for `rticks`, and `thetaticks`.
t.zh: `xticks`、`yticks`、`zticks`、`rticks` 和 `thetaticks` 函数可用来获取或设置相应坐标轴上的刻度位置及其模式。它们的形式相同，不过 `rticks` 和 `thetaticks` 目前没有模式选项。

t.en: The `xticklabels`, `yticklabels`, and `zticklabels` functions may be used to get or set the label assigned to each tick location and the labeling mode on the respective axis. Each has the same form.
t.zh: `xticklabels`、`yticklabels` 和 `zticklabels` 函数可用来获取或设置相应坐标轴上各刻度位置所对应的标签以及标签的模式，三者形式相同。

t.en: The `xtickangle`, `ytickangle`, and `ztickangle` functions may be used to get or set the rotation angle of labels for the respective axis. Each has the same form.
t.zh: `xtickangle`、`ytickangle` 和 `ztickangle` 函数可用来获取或设置相应坐标轴上标签的旋转角度，三者形式相同。

t.en: Two-dimensional Function Plotting
t.zh: 二维函数绘图

t.en: Octave can plot a function from a function handle or string defining the function without the user needing to explicitly create the data to be plotted. The function `fplot` also generates two-dimensional plots with linear axes using a function name and limits for the range of the x-coordinate instead of the x and y data. For example,
t.zh: Octave 可以根据函数句柄或定义函数的字符串直接绘制函数，不需要用户显式地生成要绘制的数据。`fplot` 函数同样生成坐标轴为线性刻度的二维图，只是它使用函数名和 x 坐标的范围，而不是 x 和 y 数据。例如，

t.zh: 生成的图与上面那张等价，但还多了一个图例，显示所绘函数的名称。

t.en: Plot a function *fcn* within the range defined by *limits*.
t.zh: 在 *limits* 所定义的范围内绘制函数 *fcn*。

t.en: *fcn* is a function handle, inline function, or string containing the name of the function to evaluate.
t.zh: *fcn* 是函数句柄、内联函数，或包含待求值函数名称的字符串。

t.en: The limits of the plot are of the form `[xlo, xhi]` or `[xlo, xhi, ylo, yhi]`. If no limits are specified the default is `[-5, 5]`.
t.zh: 绘图范围的形式为 `[xlo, xhi]` 或 `[xlo, xhi, ylo, yhi]`。如果没有指定范围，默认为 `[-5, 5]`。

t.en: The next three arguments are all optional and any number of them may be given in any order.
t.zh: 接下来的三个参数都是可选的，可以按任意顺序给出其中任意几个。

t.en: *tol* is the relative tolerance to use for the plot and defaults to 2e-3 (.2%).
t.zh: *tol* 是绘图使用的相对容差，默认为 2e-3（0.2%）。

t.en: *n* is the minimum number of points to use. When *n* is specified, the maximum stepsize will be `(xhi - xlo) / n`. More than *n* points may still be used in order to meet the relative tolerance requirement.
t.zh: *n* 是至少要使用的点数。指定 *n* 时，最大步长为 `(xhi - xlo) / n`。为了满足相对容差的要求，实际使用的点数仍可能多于 *n*。

t.en: The *fmt* argument specifies the linestyle to be used by the plot command.
t.zh: *fmt* 参数指定 plot 命令使用的线型。

t.en: Multiple property-value pairs may also be specified, but they must appear in pairs. These arguments are applied to the line objects drawn by `plot`.
t.zh: 也可以指定多组属性–值对，但它们必须成对出现。这些参数作用于 `plot` 所画出的线对象。

t.en: The full list of line properties is documented at Line Properties.
t.zh: 线对象属性的完整列表见 Line Properties 一节。

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则绘制到这个坐标轴中，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: With no output arguments, the results are immediately plotted. With two output arguments, the 2-D plot data is returned. The data can subsequently be plotted manually with `plot (x, y)`.
t.zh: 没有输出参数时，结果立即被绘制出来。有两个输出参数时，返回二维绘图数据，之后可以手动用 `plot (x, y)` 绘出。

t.zh: 编程注记：

t.en: `fplot` works best with continuous functions. Functions with discontinuities are unlikely to plot well. This restriction may be removed in the future.
t.zh: `fplot` 最适合连续函数。有间断点的函数很可能画不好。这一限制以后可能会取消。

t.en: `fplot` performance is better when the function accepts and returns a vector argument. Consider this when writing user-defined functions and use element-by-element operators such as `.*`, `./`, etc.
t.zh: 当函数接受并返回向量参数时，`fplot` 的性能更好。编写自定义函数时请考虑这一点，并使用 `.*`、`./` 等逐元素运算符。

t.en: See also: `ezplot`, `plot`.
t.zh: 另见：`ezplot`、`plot`。

t.en: Other functions that can create two-dimensional plots directly from a function include `ezplot`, `ezcontour`, `ezcontourf` and `ezpolar`.
t.zh: 其他可以直接根据函数创建二维图的函数有 `ezplot`、`ezcontour`、`ezcontourf` 和 `ezpolar`。

t.en: Plot the 2-D curve defined by the function *f*.
t.zh: 绘制函数 *f* 所定义的二维曲线。

t.zh: 函数 *f* 可以是字符串、内联函数或函数句柄，可以有一个或两个变量。如果 *f* 只有一个变量，则在定义域 `-2*pi < x < 2*pi` 上取 500 个点绘制。

t.en: If *f2v* is a function of two variables then the implicit function `f(x,y) = 0` is calculated over the meshed domain `-2*pi <= x | y <= 2*pi` with 60 points in each dimension.
t.zh: 如果 *f2v* 是二元函数，则在网格化的定义域 `-2*pi <= x | y <= 2*pi` 上、每个维度取 60 个点，计算隐函数 `f(x,y) = 0`。

t.zh: 在定义域 `-2*pi <= t <= 2*pi` 上取 500 个点绘制。

t.en: If *dom* is a two element vector, it represents the minimum and maximum values of both *x* and *y*, or *t* for a parametric plot. If *dom* is a four element vector, then the minimum and maximum values are `[xmin xmax ymin ymax]`.

t.en: If the first argument *hax* is an axes handle, then plot into this axes, rather than the current axes returned by `gca`.
t.zh: 如果第一个参数 *hax* 是坐标轴句柄，则绘制到这个坐标轴中，而不是 `gca` 返回的当前坐标轴。

t.en: The optional return value *h* is a vector of graphics handles to the created line objects.
t.zh: 可选的返回值 *h* 是一个向量，其元素是所创建线对象的图形句柄。

t.en: See also: `plot`, `ezplot3`, `ezpolar`, `ezcontour`, `ezcontourf`, `ezmesh`, `ezmeshc`, `ezsurf`, `ezsurfc`.
t.zh: 另见：`plot`、`ezplot3`、`ezpolar`、`ezcontour`、`ezcontourf`、`ezmesh`、`ezmeshc`、`ezsurf`、`ezsurfc`。

t.en: Three-Dimensional Plots
t.zh: 三维图形

t.en: The function `mesh` produces mesh surface plots. For example,
t.zh: `mesh` 函数生成网格曲面图。例如，

t.en: produces the familiar “sombrero” plot shown in fig:mesh. Note the use of the function `meshgrid` to create matrices of X and Y coordinates to use for plotting the Z data. The `ndgrid` function is similar to `meshgrid`, but works for N-dimensional matrices.
t.zh: 生成我们熟悉的“墨西哥草帽”图，如图 fig:mesh 所示。注意这里用 `meshgrid` 函数生成了 X 和 Y 坐标的矩阵，用来绘制 Z 数据。`ndgrid` 函数与 `meshgrid` 类似，但适用于 N 维矩阵。

t.en: The `meshc` function is similar to `mesh`, but also produces a plot of contours for the surface.
t.zh: `meshc` 函数与 `mesh` 类似，但同时还绘出曲面的等高线。

t.en: The `plot3` function displays arbitrary three-dimensional data, without requiring it to form a surface. For example,
t.zh: `plot3` 函数显示任意的三维数据，数据不必构成一个曲面。例如，

t.en: displays the spiral in three dimensions shown in fig:plot3.
t.zh: 显示如图 fig:plot3 所示的三维螺旋线。

t.en: Finally, the `view` function changes the viewpoint for three-dimensional plots.
t.zh: 最后，`view` 函数改变三维图形的观察视角。

t.en: Plot a 3-D wireframe mesh.
t.zh: 绘制三维线框网格图。

t.en: The wireframe mesh is plotted using rectangles. The vertices of the rectangles [*x*, *y*] are typically the output of `meshgrid`. over a 2-D rectangular region in the x-y plane. *z* determines the height above the plane of each vertex. If only a single *z* matrix is given, then it is plotted over the meshgrid `x = 1:columns (z), y = 1:rows (z)`. Thus, columns of *z* correspond to different *x* values and rows of *z* correspond to different *y* values.

t.en: Programming Note: `meshgrid` is restricted to 2-D or 3-D grid generation. The `ndgrid` function will generate 1-D through N-D grids. However, the functions are not completely equivalent. Multiple Plots on One Page

Octave can display more than one plot in a single figure. The simplest way to do this is to use the `subplot` function to divide the plot area into a series of subplot windows that are indexed by an integer. For example,

creates a figure with two separate axes, one displaying a sine wave and the other a cosine wave. The first call to subplot divides the figure into two plotting areas (two rows and one column) and makes the first plot area active. The grid of plot areas created by `subplot` is numbered in row-major order (left to right, top to bottom). After plotting a sine wave, the next call to subplot activates the second subplot area, but does not re-partition the figure.
Set up a plot grid with *rows* by *cols* subwindows and set the current axes for plotting (`gca`) to the location given by *index*.
If an axes handle *hax* is provided after the (*rows*, *cols*, *index*) arguments, the corresponding axes is turned into a subplot.
If only one numeric argument is supplied, then it must be a three digit value specifying the number of rows in digit 1, the number of columns in digit 2, and the plot index in digit 3.
The plot index runs row-wise; First, all columns in a row are numbered and then the next row is filled.

For example, a plot with 2x3 grid will have plot indices running as follows: \vskip 10pt \hfil\vbox{\offinterlineskip\hrule \halign{\vrule#&&\qquad\hfil#\hfil\qquad\vrule\cr height13pt&1&2&3\cr height12pt&&&\cr\noalign{\hrule} height13pt&4&5&6\cr height12pt&&&\cr\noalign{\hrule}}} \hfil \vskip 10pt
*index* may also be a vector. In this case, the new axes will enclose the grid locations specified. The first demo illustrates this:
The index of the subplot to make active may also be specified by its axes handle, *hax*, returned from a previous `subplot` command.
If the option `"align"` is given then the plot boxes of the subwindows will align, but this may leave no room for axes tick marks or labels.
If the option `"replace"` is given then the subplot axes will be reset, rather than just switching the current axes for plotting to the requested subplot.

The `"position"` property can be used to exactly position the subplot axes within the current figure. The option *pos* is a 4-element vector [x, y, width, height] that determines the location and size of the axes. The values in *pos* are normalized in the range [0,1].
Any property/value pairs are passed directly to the underlying axes object. The full list of properties is documented at Axes Properties.
Any previously existing axes that would be (partly) covered by the newly created axes are deleted.
If the output *hax* is requested, subplot returns the axes handle for the subplot. This is useful for modifying the properties of a subplot using `set`.

Under some circumstances, `subplot` might not be able to identify axes that it could re-use and might replace them. If `subplot` axes should be referenced repeatedly, consider creating and storing their axes handles beforehand instead of calling `subplot` repeatedly for the same position.

Manipulation of Plot Windows
By default, Octave refreshes the plot window when a prompt is printed, or when waiting for input. The `drawnow` function is used to cause a plot window to be updated.
Only figures that are modified will be updated. The `refresh` function can also be used to cause an update of the current figure, even if it is not modified.

Normally, high-level plot functions like `plot` or `mesh` call `newplot` to determine whether the state of the target axes should be initialized (the default) or if subsequent plots should be drawn on top of previous ones. To have two plots drawn over one another, use the `hold` function or manually change the axes `axesnextplot` property. For example,

Equivalent to `hold on`.

To clear the current figure, call the `clf` function. To clear the current axis, call the `cla` function. To bring the current figure to the top of the window stack, call the `shg` function. To delete a graphics object, call `delete` on its index. To close the figure window, call the `close` function.

`clf` operates by deleting child graphics objects with visible handles (HandleVisibility = `"on"`).

If the optional argument `"reset"` is specified, delete all child objects including those with hidden handles and reset all figure properties to their defaults. However, the following properties are not reset: Position, Units, PaperPosition, PaperUnits.

When called with no arguments, close the current figure. This is equivalent to `close (gcf)`. If the input *h* is a graphic handle, or vector of graphics handles, then close each figure in *h*. The figure to close may also be specified by name *figname* which is matched against the `"Name"` property of all figures.
If the argument `"all"` is given then all figures with visible handles (HandleVisibility = `"on"`) are closed.
If the additional argument `"hidden"` is given then all figures, including hidden ones, are closed.
If the additional argument `"force"` is given then figures are closed even when `"closerequestfcn"` has been altered to prevent closing the window.
If the optional output *status* is requested then Octave returns 1 if the figure windows were closed successfully.

Implementation Note: `close` operates by making the handle *h* the current figure, and then calling the function specified by the `"closerequestfcn"` property of the figure. By default, the function `closereq` is used. It is possible that the function invoked will delay or abort removing the figure. To remove a figure without executing any callback functions use `delete`. When writing a callback function to close a window do not use `close` to avoid recursion.

Use of the "interpreter" Property

`text` (such as titles, labels, legend item) and `axes` objects feature an `textinterpreter` and a `axesticklabelinterpreter` property respectively. It determines the manner in which special control sequences in the text are rendered.
The interpreter property can take three values: `"none"`, `"tex"`, `"latex"`.
"none" interpreter
If the interpreter is set to `"none"` then no special rendering occurs—the displayed text is a verbatim copy of the specified text.
"tex" interpreter

The `"tex"` interpreter implements a subset of TeX functionality when rendering text. This allows the insertion of special glyphs such as Greek characters or mathematical symbols. Special characters are inserted by using a backslash (\) character followed by a code, as shown in tab:extended.
Besides special glyphs, the formatting of the text can be changed within the string by using the codes
These codes may be used in conjunction with the { and } characters to limit the change to a part of the string. For example,
where the character `'a'` will not appear in bold font. Note that to avoid having Octave interpret the backslash character in the strings, the strings themselves should be in single quotes.
It is also possible to change the fontname and size within the text

rows.en: Specify the color as a string

t.en: Finally, superscripting and subscripting can be controlled with the `'^'` and `'_'` characters. If the `'^'` or `'_'` is followed by a { character, then all of the block surrounded by the { } pair is superscripted or subscripted. Without the { } pair, only the character immediately following the `'^'` or `'_'` is changed.
**Caution: Degree Symbol**

Conformance to both TeX and MATLAB with respect to the `\circ` symbol is impossible. While TeX translates this symbol to Unicode 2218 (U+2218), MATLAB maps this to Unicode 00B0 (U+00B0) instead. Octave has chosen to follow the TeX specification, but has added the additional symbol `\deg` which maps to the degree symbol (U+00B0).
"latex" interpreter

The `"latex"` interpreter only works if an external LaTeX tool chain is present. Three binaries are needed: `latex`, `dvipng`, and `dvisvgm`. If those binaries are installed but not on the path, one can still provide their respective path using the following environment variables: `OCTAVE_LATEX_BINARY`, `OCTAVE_DVIPNG_BINARY`, and `OCTAVE_DVISVG_BINARY`.

Note that Octave does not parse or validate the text strings when in `"latex"` mode—it is the responsibility of the programmer to generate valid strings which may include wrapping sections that should appear in Math mode with `'$'` characters. See, for example, https://www.latex-project.org/help/documentation/ for documentation about LaTeX typesetting.

For debugging purpose, a convenience environment variable, `OCTAVE_LATEX_DEBUG_FLAG`, can be set to trigger more verbose output when Octave fails to have a given text compiled by an external LaTeX engine. For example, `"x^2"` is not a valid LaTeX string and the following example should fail

! Missing $ inserted.

t.en: If no usable LaTeX tool chain is found at the first text rendering, using the `"latex"` interpreter is equivalent to `"none"`.
Printing and Saving Plots
The `print` command allows you to send plots to you printer and to save plots in a variety of formats. For example,
prints the current figure to a color PostScript printer. And,
saves the current figure to an encapsulated PostScript file called `foo.eps`.

The current graphic toolkits produce very similar graphic displays, but differ in their capability to display unusual text and in their ability to print such text. In general, the `"tex"` interpreter (default) is the best all-around performer for both on-screen display and printing. However, for the reproduction of complicated text formulas the `"latex"` interpreter is preferred. When printing with the `-painters` renderer, the default for all vector formats, two options may be considered:
Use the `-svgconvert` option to allow for rendering LaTeX formulas. Note that the glyph are rendered as path and the original textual info are lost.

Use one of the `-d*latex*` devices to produce a .tex file (plus supporting .eps or .pdf files) to be further processed by an external LaTeX engine. Note that the `print` function will first set the interpreter of all strings to `"latex"`, which means all strings must be valid LaTeX strings.

When using the SVG based backend `-svgconvert`, faces are rendered as triangles. In some cases, some viewers might display fine lines where those triangles share an edge. These options control whether all triangles that share edges are merged into polygons (`-polymerge-all` which might take some time for graphics consisting of many triangles -- including line markers), only consecutive polygons are merged (`-polymerge`), or no triangles are merged at all (`-no-polymerge`). By default, only consecutive triangles sharing an edge are merged, unless the printed figure contains patch or surface graphics objects in which case all triangles that are sharing an edge are merged.

Generate a LaTeX file `filename.tex` for the text portions of a plot and a file `filename.(ps|eps|pdf)` for the remaining graphics. The graphics file suffix .ps|eps|pdf is determined by the specified device type. The LaTeX file produced by the `standalone` option can be processed directly by LaTeX. The file generated without the `standalone` option is intended to be included from another LaTeX document. In either case, the LaTeX file contains an `\includegraphics` command so that the generated graphics file is automatically included when the LaTeX file is processed. The text that is written to the LaTeX file contains the strings **exactly** as they were specified in the plot. If any special characters of the TeX mode interpreter were used, the file must be edited before LaTeX processing. Specifically, the special characters must be enclosed with dollar signs (`$ … $`), and other characters that are recognized by LaTeX may also need editing (e.g., braces). The `pdflatex` device, and any of the `standalone` formats, are not available with the Gnuplot toolkit.
